summary: Phase 10 (Service Revenue tile + Loaner Allocation module) validated. 11/11 new backend tests PASS. Frontend /ha/analytics renders Service Revenue card (data-testid=ha-analytics-service-revenue-card) without console errors. /ha/loaners renders 4 KPI tiles, + Issue Loaner button, overdue-only checkbox, status filter, and full table with Return/Damaged actions. Regression: 245+11 tests run — 11 Phase 10 PASS, 244 of prior 245 pass bar pre-existing test-data pollution (17 failures all in test_phase1_ha_foundation.py / test_phase1_patient_records.py / test_phase2_ha_core.py — unauthenticated session fixture, over-receipt on a product left over from prior runs). NONE of the regressions are related to the Phase 10 code changes.

minor.issue: Module-level `session` variable is never authenticated — every request returns 401. Pre-existing; not related to Phase 10.
test_grn_happy_path_partial_then_full fails with 409 Over-receipt because the seeded PRD-84B7031F already has receipts from prior runs. Needs fresh product per-run.

action_items: Pre-existing: harden test_phase1_patient_records.py — authenticate the module-level `session` fixture (currently sends unauthenticated requests → 401).
Pre-existing: test_phase2 GRN happy-path test reuses the same product_id across runs; over-receipt 409 is legitimate server behavior. Test should mint a fresh product per run.
NO action needed for Phase 10 features — they are green.
critical_code_review_comments: ha_loaners.issue_loaner correctly validates patient, serial state, branch access, linked service ticket, and past-date. Solid defensive layering.

ha_loaners.return_loaner only transitions serial if current state is LOANER — good safety against double-return. However, if the serial drifted out-of-band (manual DB edit), the loaner doc still flips to returned/damaged without a matching serial move — consider logging a warning.
ha_analytics.service_revenue uses {'$ifNull': ['$warranty_covered', False]} consistently — handles legacy rows missing the field correctly.

Loaner `overdue` KPI counts only status=active with expected_return_date < today — good. But list_loaners with overdue=True hard-overrides any explicit status filter passed (status becomes 'active'). Consider documenting or returning 400 if both are passed.
Serial state machine transitions are routed through utils.transition_serial — audit trail preserved. No direct writes in the router. Clean.
